data.body: Windows evidence for this ticket: the scheduled 'sweep (windows)' job (run 41282090856, job 124775894326, d8801e4dda4) installs with 'uv pip install ".[dev,reviewbot,ui]"' instead of from uv.lock, so it already runs pytest 9.2.0 (the dev extra excludes only 9.1.0 and 9.1.1). It shows exactly the 6 State.config failures this ticket lists. Moving to 9.2.0 here would also clear them on Windows; until then they remain in the advisory sweep.
